clearancePolicy: Use only published signed road vertical clearances for vehicles (TMR Structure Clearances spatial layers, BCC Open Data road-restrictions, Queensland Rail SEQ low bridges, TMR Bridge/Culvert Restrictions notices). Prefer TMR/BCC/QR published figures over invented heights. Physical roadside signs always override digital pack data — packs can be inaccurate or stale (e.g. after resurfacing). The in-app clearance buffer exists in part for that data lag versus signs, not only vehicle/cargo variance. If a crossing has no published road clearance (high open river spans), omit clearanceHeightM and set clearanceStatus to unknown. Pedestrian/cycle-only bridges are not_applicable. Never invent mock demo heights or heights for bridges absent from the cited sources. Never treat Maritime Safety Queensland vessel air draft above HAT as a truck road clearance.
sources: TMR Structure Clearances in Queensland, retrieved 2026-11-23: https://www.data.qld.gov.au/dataset/structure-clearances-queensland (ArcGIS StateRoadInformation MapServer layers 21 <4.6 m and 22 ≥4.6–<5.4 m: https://spatial-gis.information.qld.gov.au/arcgis/rest/services/Transportation/StateRoadInformation/MapServer)

TMR Queensland — Bridge and culvert restrictions hub, retrieved 2026-11-23: https://www.tmr.qld.gov.au/business-industry/heavy-vehicles/bridge-and-culvert-restrictions (prefer with Structure Clearances; not used as invented height)
Brisbane City Council Open Data — Road height restrictions (dataset road-restrictions), retrieved 2026-11-23: https://data.brisbane.qld.gov.au/explore/dataset/road-restrictions/

Queensland Rail — Low rail bridges in South East Queensland, retrieved 2026-11-23: https://www.queenslandrail.com.au/forcustomers/safetysecurity/railbridges (road-under-rail signed clearances; location map coordinates from the same page)
